messages:
ana: planning to push release v2.14 to prod tonight at 00:30 PT. Need a quick observability preflight + smoke owner. who can take the checks and dashboard tweaks?

mike: I can own smoke and traces. 00:30 PT works for me. will run the usual workload profile and check tail latencies.

sophia: i'm on-call but can be available for rollback pings. what exact widgets/thresholds should we touch so alerts don't spam?

ana: (typo) ana: sorry — the main asks: adjust 95p latency on the model-latency panel to 1200ms for the canary line, add a small trace view that filters service=runtime + span=decode, and a quick health row that hits /health and /v1/generate with short prompt. keep normal prod alerts unchanged except temporarily suppress pager for model-queue-length during the 30-min window.

mike: got it. i'll add a temporary dashboard (release-quick-checks) under /console/dashboards and a trace link. quick smoke script i'll run:

```bash
# smoke script for release v2.14
curl -sS -f https://api.redwood.example/health || exit 1
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"short test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_KEY' || exit 1
```

mike: plan: run warmup at 00:10 PT, canary at 00:30 PT (3 nodes), then scale to full at +10m if tail latencies < 850ms and error rate < 0.1%. i'll post results here.

jordan: I'll lower the severity on model-queue-length alert from P1->P2 for the 00:00-01:00 PT window, and add a note in the alert runbook that this is a scheduled release. will revert severity after 01:10 PT.

sophia: thanks. can we also add a trace-span heatmap for tokenize->encode? that's been noisy on long prompts.

mike: yup adding span heatmap and a tag to exclude background batch jobs from the canary view.

ana: (again typo) ana: please also leave an easy rollback command in the thread if anything goes sideways. suggested rollback: `rb v2.13 --force` from release CLI.

mike: noted. i'll paste the rollback steps before the canary push.

devops-bot: deploy scheduled: user=ana, id=rel_2_14, window=2026-03-19T07:30:00Z (00:30 PT). automated preflight checks queued.

mike: preflight results: health ok on staging, model latency profile looks normal. will start warmup at 00:10 PT and post quick metrics snapshots.

sophia: i'll be watching traces and available for rollback. ping me with `@sophia` if you trigger rb.

ana: thanks team — i'll mark this release in the release calendar and leave this thread pinned for post-mortem notes. :thumbsup:

mike: thumbs up. all set on my end.

jordan: severity reverted to P1 at 01:12 PT — all clear.

mike: final note: added a small 'smoke-ok' marker to the dashboard you can click to indicate manual pass/fail. helps SREs triage post-deploy.
